text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Clear skies. A massive crowd has gathered for the mock race
featuring Jungle Pocket. I'm here cheering with her friends.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Oraaah—whoa, what?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, yes. Excellent.
Just like this... onward to the far side of potential.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having botched her start, Jungle Pocket was visibly rattled.
Desperate to catch up, she had completely lost her own rhythm.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Dammit—Tachyon...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her face twisted in frustration as her surging fighting spirit spun its wheels.
Meanwhile, Agnes Tachyon up ahead smoothly pulled away, further and further—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —blazing past the finish post like a beam of pure light.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
A final three-furlong split of around thirty-five seconds... I see.
—Nowhere near enough, not yet.

text_block_list.name: Mid-Career Trainer
text_block_list.text:
What a magnificent run, Agnes Tachyon...!
Such breathtaking speed... and to think she hasn't even debuted yet!

text_block_list.name: Spectator Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Brutal... Honestly, I feel bad for the girl who lost.
She might've won any other race, but getting crushed like that... that's gotta sting.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Guh, she's so... How can she be so far ahead of me...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Jungle Pocket is strong.
She has the latent talent to aim for the title of "the strongest." But...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Could even a girl like her
be brushed aside so effortlessly by Agnes Tachyon—?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hah, hah...! Urrrgh, dammit...!
RAAAAH!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: —Guh............ Dammit all...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ever since that race, Jungle Pocket has been running nonstop.
The shock of witnessing such overwhelming power is immeasurable—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: —Heard that chick's debut got set.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With that level of skill, she's bound to make a spectacular debut.
Conversely, anyone debuting in the same year will run into a massive roadblock—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: I'm debuting the same year.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: She's incredible. And yeah, it's a fact she's stronger than me right now.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: —Which is exactly why I'm gonna go knock her flat!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
How can she face everything head-on with such directness?
Why go out of her way to walk such a thorny path—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: You really need a reason to wanna win?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
If you're born an umamusume, you wanna run. If you run, you wanna be the "strongest."
You beat the tough ones over and over, climb to the top, and take the crown.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: —'Cause that's the absolute coolest way to live, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That's right—if you aim to be the "strongest," you can't back down here.
You can't claim that title without overcoming the strong.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Aargh, damn it! Tachyon, you bastard...!
Nnngh, not yet... Not done yet...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I think about how to make her stronger and what she's missing.
...In the heat of her fighting spirit, she tends to lose focus over minor things.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Fix what?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
There's somethin' I need to work on, ain't there?
Tell me how to get stronger.
choice_data_list: Yeah. First, we need to build up your concentration...!
Right. First, we need to build up your concentration...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With that, Jungle Pocket's fierce fighting spirit will shine in races.
And that spirit will unleash an explosive, enduring late surge down the final stretch—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...! Heh... Sounds good. —Hell yeah!
What else? Got anything more?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Getting used to tight courses is crucial too... Rather than forcing speed on corners,
we could adjust your lane positioning. Pour everything into the final stretch and blow right past them!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah!
I'll master every damn thing and become the "strongest"!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: *haaah*... Man, I'm beat. Can't take another step.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, thanks.
...Hey. You've got videos of Fuji-san's races, right? Mind if I watch?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... Fuji-san really is incredible.
Running in mock races made me realize just how amazing she is all over again.
choice_data_list: Why do you... care so much about Fuji Kiseki?
Why do you... care so much about Fuji Kiseki?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Oh... Right, guess I haven't told ya yet. The very first
Twinkle Series race I ever watched was Fuji-san's.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I'd only ever run in the streets back then.
So I went to see what these "proper races" were all about, acting all cocky.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
—And it totally blew me away. Just when I thought it was a close match,
she shifted up another gear... and left 'em in the dust in a blink!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
To blow past all those monsters on a stage packed with the best...!
That was the kind of "strongest" I was searching for.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I wanna win like that too!
I wanna run cool, fight cool races!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Once I realized the only way was to jump right in,
I couldn't sit still anymore. Next thing I knew, I'd enrolled at Tracen.
choice_data_list: There's no reason not to aim for the "strongest"!
There's no reason not to aim for the "strongest"!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Right? Knew you'd get it!
So, what about you? How'd you become a fan of Fuji-san?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It all started when my brother became her primary doctor.
Her four races since debut—every single one was truly the work of the "strongest."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Your brother...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For the first time, I reveal my brother's lingering regret. With her Derby dreams shattered,
he and I could no longer talk about our shared dreams together.
choice_data_list: ...I want to clear away that regret.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Fuji-san... she always acts like it's no big deal, though.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Even after I came here, she's taught me all kinds of stuff.
She's always perfect, never showing anything but her coolest side. But—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ............There's no way it didn't eat her up inside.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: She was supposed to take the Derby. No doubt about it.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
All right!! Time to put in some more training after all!!
I'm countin' on your coaching, got it?
choice_data_list: ...! Are you sure you want me?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Huh? What kinda question is that?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, we're training every day until the Debut Selection, so
no slacking off. Meet here this afternoon. You guys help out too!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl with Wolf Cut
text_block_list.text: Got it! Let us help out too!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl with Lip Piercing
text_block_list.text: Pacing, running errands, whatever you need! So, look forward to working with you too.
choice_data_list: Got it, leave it to me!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah!! I'll win the selection race, crush Tachyon—
and the Derby is mine!!
